items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation for the given RepositoryMetadata and custom RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments.
items.translation: 返回给定 RepositoryMetadata 和自定义 RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments 的 RepositoryInformation。

items.source: RepositoryInformation based on RepositoryMetadata collected at build time.
items.translation: 基于构建时收集的RepositoryMetadata的RepositoryInformation。

items.source: Common base class for RepositoryInformation that delays resolution of RepositoryMetadata and the repository base to the latest possible time.
items.translation: RepositoryInformation 的通用基类，将 RepositoryMetadata 和仓库基类的解析延迟到尽可能晚的时间。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation to determine meta-information about the repository being used.
items.translation: 返回一个RepositoryInformation，用于确定有关正在使用的存储库的元信息。

items.source: Creates a repository of the repository base class defined in the given RepositoryInformation using reflection.
items.translation: 使用反射创建由给定RepositoryInformation定义的存储库基类的存储库。

items.source: Manipulates the ProxyFactory, e.g. add further interceptors to it.
items.translation: 操作 ProxyFactory，例如向其添加更多拦截器。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation for the given domain type.
items.translation: 返回给定实体类型对应的RepositoryInformation。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation for the given repository interface.
items.translation: 返回给定存储库接口的RepositoryInformation。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation for the given domain class.
items.translation: 返回给定领域类的RepositoryInformation。

items.source: Create an instance of the repository base class providing store-specific built-in repository functionality of a typical CrudRepository.
items.translation: 创建一个存储库基类实例，提供典型CrudRepository的特定于存储的内置存储库功能。

items.source: Ahead-of-Time (AOT) generation for Spring Data repositories.
items.translation: Spring Data 存储库的提前生成（AOT）。

items.source: Support classes for repository namespace and JavaConfig integration.
items.translation: 支持仓库命名空间与 JavaConfig 集成的辅助类。

items.source: Core abstractions for repository implementation.
items.translation: 仓库实现的核心抽象。

items.source: Base classes to implement repositories for various data stores.
items.translation: 用于实现各种数据存储库的基础类。

items.source: Support classes for integration of the repository programming model with 3rd party frameworks.
items.translation: 支持将仓库编程模型与第三方框架集成的辅助类。
